# Cell

```csharp
public sealed class Cell
```

Namespace `SharpCell` · package `SharpCell`

A handle to one cell position. Creating a handle does not create the cell; storage is allocated only when a value or formula is set.

## Properties

<a id="address"></a>
### Address

```csharp
public string Address { get; }
```

The A1 address without the sheet name, such as `B2`.

<a id="column"></a>
### Column

```csharp
public int Column { get; }
```

The column number, from 1 (A is 1).

<a id="formula"></a>
### Formula

```csharp
public string? Formula { get; set; }
```

Formula text starting with '=' (added if missing), or null for no formula. The text is parsed on assignment; invalid text throws [FormulaParseException](SharpCell.FormulaParseException.md) and leaves the cell unchanged.

**Exceptions**

- `InvalidOperationException`: The cell is part of an array formula other than its top-left cell.

<a id="row"></a>
### Row

```csharp
public int Row { get; }
```

The row number, from 1.

<a id="value"></a>
### Value

```csharp
public CellValue Value { get; set; }
```

The cell's [CellValue](SharpCell.CellValue.md): a constant, or the formula's result as of the last calculation (values do not change until [Workbook.Recalculate](SharpCell.Workbook.md#recalculate-cancellationtoken)). Setting a value removes the formula. Cells hold scalars only: Missing, arrays and lambdas cannot be stored.

**Exceptions**

- `InvalidOperationException`: The cell is part of an array formula other than its top-left cell.

<a id="worksheet"></a>
### Worksheet

```csharp
public Worksheet Worksheet { get; }
```

The sheet the cell belongs to.
